date_note: Plea entered Monday 16 November per The Record and heise (both published 17 November).
exec: A prosecution of a Lapsus$ member for the Rockstar, BT/EE, Revolut and Uber intrusions reaches sentencing.
plain: A Lapsus$ gang member has pleaded guilty in a London court over the 2022 hack of Rockstar Games that leaked early Grand Theft Auto 6 footage. Sentencing is on 23 November.
summary: Heise reports that Arion Kurtaj, 21, a member of the Lapsus$ group who leaked about 90 videos of unfinished Grand Theft Auto 6 in 2022, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court, London. Heise says he also admitted attacks on BT/EE, Revolut and Uber, citing the Crown Prosecution Service. Sentencing is set for 23 November 2026.
title: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj pleads guilty over 2022 Rockstar and GTA 6 leak hack

validation.note: The Record (headline only) and heise (full text read) report the plea; details come from heise.
